reasons: Rule is an insert-type (missing) rule and the rationale confirms no insurance obligation exists anywhere — the cited sections (Security, Risk of Loss, Data Protection) do not create any coverage undertaking, so a missing classification is appropriate for a hosting vendor that processes Customer data.

The inserted paragraph tracks the playbook's model language and reaches the preferred position (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request, term plus one year), and is added as a standalone paragraph in the general/miscellaneous area (after 14.12 Risk of Loss) without altering the existing risk-of-loss text — the minimal edit for an insertion.

Comment is accurate, concise, in the required first-person-plural tone with the [Playbook] prefix, states what changed and why, and offers a fallback on limits consistent with the E&O 1M / cyber 2M fallback.

Deterministic checks all pass; the only nit is cosmetic — the rendered heading is 'Insurance' without the section number 14.12A referenced in the rationale, which does not affect substance or enforceability.
